vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of furniture you eat at; a place in a restaurant
vocabulary.example: A table for four, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: free to use or get
vocabulary.example: Do you have any tables available?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a list of the food in a restaurant
vocabulary.example: Could we see the menu, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to suggest something as good
vocabulary.example: What do you recommend?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who doesn't eat meat; food without meat
vocabulary.example: Do you have vegetarian dishes?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a thick piece of meat
vocabulary.example: I'd like the steak medium, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how much meat is cooked: a little / in the middle / completely
vocabulary.example: I like my steak well-done.

vocabulary.meaning_en: long thin pieces of fried potato
vocabulary.example: Does it come with fries?

vocabulary.meaning_en: part of the price or the dish
vocabulary.example: Is the salad included?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the foods that a dish is made from
vocabulary.example: What are the ingredients in this sauce?

vocabulary.meaning_en: hot, with strong pepper taste
vocabulary.example: Is this soup spicy?

vocabulary.meaning_en: small hard fruits like almonds
vocabulary.example: I'm allergic to nuts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: getting sick from a certain food or thing
vocabulary.example: My son is allergic to milk.

vocabulary.meaning_en: good for your body
vocabulary.example: Do you have any healthy options?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of paper or cloth to clean your mouth and hands
vocabulary.example: Could I get some more napkins?

vocabulary.meaning_en: filling a cup or glass again
vocabulary.example: Can I get a refill on my drink?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the paper that shows what you must pay
vocabulary.example: Could we have the bill, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: tasting very good
vocabulary.example: The food was delicious.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the work waiters do for customers
vocabulary.example: The service was excellent.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the feeling or mood of a place
vocabulary.example: This restaurant has a lovely atmosphere.

vocabulary.meaning_en: food eaten at one time (breakfast, lunch, dinner)
vocabulary.example: Thank you for a wonderful meal.

fine_lines.title: Can I vs May I vs Could I
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الثلاثة تُستخدم للطلب. Can I عادية، Could I أكثر أدبًا، May I أكثر رسمية ورقيًا. كلها صحيحة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: All three make requests. "Can I" is normal, "Could I" is more polite, "May I" is the most formal. All are correct.

examples.sentence: May I see the menu, please?

fine_lines.title: rare vs medium vs well-done
fine_lines.explanation_ar: درجات طهي اللحم: rare قليل الطهي، medium متوسط، well-done مطهو تمامًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: How cooked the meat is: rare = a little, medium = in the middle, well-done = fully cooked.

examples.sentence: Can I get the steak medium, please?

fine_lines.title: bill vs check
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما فاتورة المطعم: bill في بريطانيا، check في أمريكا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both are the restaurant bill: "bill" in the UK, "check" in the US.

examples.sentence: Could we have the bill, please?

expressions.phrase: Hi, a table for two, please.
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for a table when you arrive.
expressions.example: Hi, a table for two, please.

expressions.phrase: Good evening. Do you have any tables available?
expressions.meaning_ar: مساء الخير، هل لديكم طاولات متاحة؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking if there is a free table.
expressions.example: Good evening. Do you have any tables available for four?

expressions.phrase: Could we sit by the window, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكننا الجلوس بجانب النافذة من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for a table near the window.
expressions.example: Could we sit by the window, please? The view is nice.

expressions.phrase: Thank you for your help.
expressions.meaning_en: Thanking the staff politely.
expressions.example: Thank you for your help. We'll wait here.

expressions.phrase: May I see the menu, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني رؤية القائمة من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to ask for the menu.
expressions.example: May I see the menu, please?

expressions.phrase: I'll have the chicken sandwich, please.
expressions.meaning_en: Ordering a dish.
expressions.example: I'll have the chicken sandwich, please.

expressions.phrase: What do you recommend for vegetarians?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for a suggestion without meat.
expressions.example: What do you recommend for vegetarians?

expressions.phrase: Can I get the steak medium, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على الستيك متوسط الطهي؟
expressions.meaning_en: Ordering with extra details.
expressions.example: Can I get the steak medium, please, with extra salad?

expressions.phrase: Does it come with fries?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking what is included with the dish.
expressions.example: The burger looks good. Does it come with fries?

expressions.phrase: I'd like a glass of water, please.
expressions.meaning_ar: أود كوبًا من الماء من فضلك.
expressions.meaning_en: Ordering a drink politely.
expressions.example: I'd like a glass of water, please.

expressions.phrase: What are the ingredients in this pasta dish?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking what is in the food.
expressions.example: What are the ingredients in this pasta dish? I can't eat cheese.

expressions.phrase: Is this soup spicy?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking about the taste.
expressions.example: Is this soup spicy? I don't like hot food.

expressions.phrase: Could you make it without nuts, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك تحضيره بدون مكسرات من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking to change a dish (for example because of an allergy).
expressions.example: I'm allergic. Could you make it without nuts, please?

expressions.phrase: Do you have any healthy options?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for healthy food.
expressions.example: I'm on a diet. Do you have any healthy options?

expressions.phrase: How long will the food take?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking how long you must wait.
expressions.example: We're in a hurry. How long will the food take?

expressions.phrase: Could I get some more napkins, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على مزيد من المناديل؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for extra napkins.
expressions.example: Could I get some more napkins, please? The kids made a mess.

expressions.phrase: Can I get a refill on my drink?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for your glass to be filled again.
expressions.example: Excuse me, can I get a refill on my drink?

expressions.phrase: Could I have this dish with less salt?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على هذا الطبق بملح أقل؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for a change in cooking.
expressions.example: Could I have this dish with less salt, please?

expressions.phrase: Could I get a box for this, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على علبة لهذا؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking to take the rest of your food home.
expressions.example: I can't finish it. Could I get a box for this, please?

expressions.phrase: Could we have the bill, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكننا الحصول على الفاتورة من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking to pay.
expressions.example: Could we have the bill, please?

expressions.phrase: The food was delicious, thank you.
expressions.meaning_en: Giving a nice comment about the food.
expressions.example: How was everything? - The food was delicious, thank you.

expressions.phrase: The service was excellent.
expressions.meaning_en: Praising the waiters.
expressions.example: The service was excellent. Thank you.

expressions.phrase: This restaurant has a lovely atmosphere.
expressions.meaning_en: Praising the place.
expressions.example: This restaurant has a lovely atmosphere. We'll come again.

expressions.phrase: It was a great dining experience.
expressions.meaning_en: The whole visit was very good.
expressions.example: Thank you, it was a great dining experience.

expressions.phrase: Thank you for a wonderful meal.
expressions.meaning_en: A warm thank you at the end.
expressions.example: Thank you for a wonderful meal!

grammar.title: Ordering: I'll have... / I'd like...
grammar.explanation_ar: لطلب الطعام نقول I'll have + اسم الطبق (سآخذ...) أو I'd like + اسم (أود...). كلاهما مهذب وطبيعي، ونضيف please في النهاية.
grammar.explanation_en: To order, say "I'll have + dish" or "I'd like + dish". Both are polite and natural. Add "please" at the end.
examples: I'll have the chicken sandwich, please.
I'd like a glass of water, please.
I'll have the soup to start.

grammar.title: Polite requests: Can I / Could I / May I + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: نطلب شيئًا لأنفسنا بـ Can I أو Could I أو May I + الفعل الأصلي. May I هي الأكثر رسمية، وCould I مهذبة جدًا.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask for something for yourself with Can I / Could I / May I + base verb. "May I" is the most formal; "Could I" is very polite.
examples: May I see the menu, please?
Could I get some more napkins?
Can I get a refill on my drink?

grammar.title: Could you + verb + without / with less...
grammar.explanation_ar: لطلب تغيير في الطبق نقول Could you make it + without + اسم (بدون) أو with less/more + اسم (بكمية أقل/أكثر).
grammar.explanation_en: To change a dish: "Could you make it without + noun" or "with less/more + noun".
examples: Could you make it without nuts, please?
Could I have it with less salt?
Could you make it with more sauce?
